question: List all five states identified as having enacted laws regulating deepfakes in elections before 2024.

expected.answer: California, Michigan, Washington, Texas, and Minnesota.

evidence.text: Before 2024, only five states—California, Michigan, Washington, Texas, and Minnesota—had enacted laws regulating deepfakes in elections.

question: List the six countries and optimism percentages explicitly contrasted in the Public Opinion highlights.

expected.answer: China 83%; Indonesia 80%; Thailand 77%; Canada 40%; United States 39%; Netherlands 36%.

evidence.text: A large majority of people believe AI-powered products and services offer more benefits than drawbacks in countries like China (83%), Indonesia (80%), and Thailand (77%), while only a minority share this view in Canada (40%), the United States (39%), and the Netherlands (36%).

question: Name the four researchers recognized by the two AI-related Nobel Prizes highlighted for 2024, grouped by prize.

expected.answer: Chemistry: Demis Hassabis and John Jumper. Physics: John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton.
required_facts: Chemistry: Demis Hassabis and John Jumper
Physics: John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton

evidence.text: Google DeepMind’s Demis Hassabis and John Jumper won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their pioneering work on protein folding with AlphaFold.
John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton received the Nobel Prize in Physics for their foundational contributions to neural networks.
